name: USDGO
oneLiner: USDGO is OSL's yield-bearing Solana dollar issued with Anchorage Digital Bank, passing EFFR-linked reserve yield to holders.
collateral: U.S. Treasuries, cash, and high-quality liquid assets held by Anchorage Digital Bank, with reserve yield linked to the Effective Federal Funds Rate.
pegMechanism: 1:1 USD redemption through Anchorage Digital Bank under U.S. federal oversight

proofOfReserves.provider: Big Four accounting firm via Anchorage Digital Bank

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDGO is publicly described as a U.S. dollar token issued by Anchorage Digital Bank with 1:1 redemption and reserve attestations.

genius.notes: Issuer materials identify Anchorage Digital Bank as USDGO issuer, but Pharos found no token-specific public OCC GENIUS approval as of review.

mintAuthority.summary: USDGO is a Token-2022 issuer token whose live mint authority and permanent delegate are the same Solana address; operational custody for that address is not verified.

controls.label: USDGO Token-2022 mint authority and permanent delegate
controls.evidence: The USDGO Token-2022 mint reported this address as both mintAuthority and permanent delegate at finalized slot 421873034; metadata identifies USDGO as an Anchorage Digital Bank-issued token for the OSL ecosystem.

review.evidence: Solana Token-2022 mint reads verified the same live address for USDGO mint authority and permanent delegate, with issuer metadata linking the token to Anchorage Digital Bank.
